language.title: Language community to analyse
language.description: Steam language code of the player community you care about. Built-in translation-complaint keywords exist for all listed languages.

appIds.title: Specific Steam app IDs (optional)
appIds.description: Analyse only these games and skip discovery. Leave empty to discover games via the filters below.

steamTagIds.title: Steam tag IDs for discovery
steamTagIds.description: Numeric Steam tag IDs, e.g. 492 = Indie, 122 = RPG, 1663 = FPS, 4182 = Simulation, 599 = Roguelike. Games must carry all listed tags. Only used when appIds is empty.

releasedWithinMonths.title: Released within the last N months
releasedWithinMonths.description: Discovery only looks at games released within this window.

minReviews.title: Minimum total reviews
minReviews.description: Skip games with fewer total Steam reviews (all languages).

maxReviews.title: Maximum total reviews
maxReviews.description: Skip games with more total reviews. Useful to focus on indie-sized titles that still answer their support email.

maxGames.title: Maximum games to analyse
maxGames.description: Hard cap on analysed games per run. Each analysed game is one billable event.

reviewPagesPerGame.title: Review pages per game (100 reviews each)
reviewPagesPerGame.description: How many pages of recent reviews in the target language to scan for complaints. 1 is enough for indie titles.

maxQuotes.title: Max quoted complaints per game
maxQuotes.description: How many complaint excerpts to keep per game in complaintQuotes.

extraKeywords.title: Extra complaint keywords
extraKeywords.description: Added to the built-in keyword list for the chosen language (case-insensitive substring match).

minOpportunityScore.title: Minimum opportunity score to output
minOpportunityScore.description: Games scoring below this are analysed but not pushed (and not billed).

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel games. Keep low; Steam rate-limits aggressively.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Delay between Steam requests (seconds)
requestDelaySeconds.description: Global polite delay between requests. Lower values risk HTTP 429.
